verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents a REST-style Platform API (quotes, sessions), a TypeScript Web SDK, and a React Native SDK. An OpenAPI 3.1 spec is described as able to generate typed clients for any language. Its 'your flow, our rails' model implies MoonPay handles crypto delivery, but the evidence never explicitly says it abstracts nodes, gas, or chain mechanics, and probes found no spec at the standard OpenAPI paths. missing for 10: explicit documentation of gas/node/chain abstraction, first-party client libraries beyond JS/TS/React Native (other languages rely on codegen), a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I never operate blockchain infrastructure — the platform abstracts nodes, gas, and chain mechanics behind a conventional REST API with client libraries in my language

citations.quote: Build your own on-ramp and off-ramp on MoonPay's APIs and SDKs. Your UI, your flow, our rails.
The MoonPay Developer Platform API is defined using an OpenAPI 3.1 specification. You can use this spec to generate typed clients for any language.
The Web SDK targets first-party browser apps. It ships with TypeScript types for autocomplete and inference.
@moonpay/platform-sdk-react-native — for iOS and Android apps built with React Native.
